snippet.title: Mermade - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mermade on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5054190/Mermade
Play on Itch: https://aomame.itch.io/mermade

We will be exhibiting the demo at Gamescom 2026 for two days in the Indie area as part of the Raw Talent Booth, the exact dates at which we will be there are not yet set.

In "Mermade" the childhood fantasy of becoming a mermaid is turned into a cruel and twisted reality. You play as a human who was experimented on against her will, robbed of her legs and stitched together with a fishtail. Faced with this new reality, you have to escape—whatever way you can—while surviving the dangers lurking within the facility with other failed experiments.


This demo was created by a German team of 6 university students + 3 lovely soundies in roughly 3 and 1/2 months, we hope you enjoy and that it isn't too buggy
